from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs')
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)
path=root/'task-df70b7d2.py'
source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            r0 = min(y for y,x in cells); r1 = max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y,x in cells); c1 = max(x for y,x in cells)
            # A hollow rectangular outline has a complete, single-color border
            # and an empty interior. Fill by parity of its enclosed area.
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            perimeter = all(grid[y][x] == color for y in (r0,r1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[y][x] == color for x in (c0,c1) for y in range(r0,r1+1))
            interior_empty = all(grid[y][x] == bg for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1))
            if perimeter and interior_empty:
                fill = 7 if ((r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1)) % 2 else 2
                for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                        out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
